videos.title: All You Need Is an Orchestra — and Some Magic | Jacob Collier & VSO School of Music Orchestra | TED
videos.author: TED
videos.description: Jacob Collier walks onstage to conduct an orchestra ... but none of the musicians know what song they're about to play. In a joyful experiment in live music-making, Collier pieces together an iconic song with the VSO School of Music Orchestra (and a little help from the audience in the TED Theater).
